entities.summary: Carvalhal Benfeito is one of twelve civil parishes (freguesias) in the municipality of Caldas da Rainha, Portugal. The civil parish has an area of 13.95 square kilometres (5.39 sq mi) and had a population of 1,279 at the 2011 census.
